profile.summary: A Vallejo, California company that develops and sells curriculum and training for schools, aimed at students of color. Its main course, Mastering Our Cultural Identity, uses youth culture to help students explore identity, manage emotions and build purpose. It also offers other curricula, such as an ethnic studies course.
